review_state: production rev 1 - M1, awaiting owner look review
purpose: Creature stage food (PROPOSED): a lumpy blue-green leaf clump with amber fruit; the Fruit mesh is drawn only while ripe. Both materials take a MultiMesh instance colour.

textures.name: T_CreatureFruitBush_Albedo
textures.packing: greyscale albedo detail (baked AO darkens crevices), times each material's base colour

textures.name: T_CreatureFruitBush_ORM
textures.packing: R occlusion, G roughness, B metallic

pivot: under the bush on the ground (Godot y = 0)
instance_tint: M_BushLeaf.tres and M_BushFruit.tres (mapped in the .glb.import) set vertex_color_use_as_albedo, so a MultiMesh instance colour tints them; white draws them as baked.

reduction.method: Blender collapse decimation within a surface tolerance per piece; full-detail shading baked to the normal map

provenance: Authored procedurally in Blender by tools/blender/make_creature_world.py; no external or generated meshes. Textures baked in Blender from procedural shaders; the field tiles are periodic sine sums and wrapped Voronoi in numpy, so they repeat without seams.
